item.title: How to find the exact song on Instagram with an ISRC code
item.description: Title search on Instagram often returns covers and look-alikes. Searching with the song's ISRC code points to one exact recording. Here is how.

item.title: Why a song is not available on Instagram, and what you can do
item.description: The real reasons a song is missing or blocked in Instagram's music library, from country licensing to account type, and the fixes that stay within the rules.

item.title: What is an ISRC code? A plain guide
item.description: An ISRC is the 12-character code that identifies one recording of a song. What the parts mean, who assigns it, and where to find one.

item.title: Why business accounts see less music on Instagram
item.description: Chart songs missing from your Instagram music picker? Business accounts get a smaller, royalty-free library. Why that is, and your options within the rules.

item.title: How to find the ISRC of any song
item.description: Four ways to find a song's ISRC code: look it up by name in seconds, check your distributor, read the file's tags, or ask the label.
